title: Real-time multi-view 3D reconstruction
alt: Multi-view reconstruction system with a reconstructed human figure
description: A multi-camera reconstruction system that shares vertices during voxel splitting. The original system achieved 10 frames per second with eight cameras on an Intel i7-950 PC with 4 GB of RAM.

title: Vision-based autonomous UAV landing
description: A real-time landing system using a visible high-brightness flashlight for localization at distances up to 400 metres, including strong lighting conditions. Demonstrated autonomous landings without differential GPS and participated in the AVIC Cup International UAV Innovation Grand Prix.

title: Seeing and tracking through occlusion
alt: Multi-camera detection and tracking of people through occlusion
description: A real-time system combining multi-camera detection, synthetic aperture imaging, and multi-person tracking. A hybrid imaging model helps locate and observe people in challenging, occluded scenes. Research published at CVPR 2011.
